page0.text:
"We'll patrol Miyama tonight. It's been weird around here lately, so we should make sure our home turf is secure."
"I agree. Although the naked eye cannot detect everything, we should glean some valuable information if we are thorough in our search."

page1.text:
...Let's check out the nearby neighborhoods first.
We head down to the intersection and patrol the European-style neighborhoods.
If we don't find anything, then we can just move on to Shinto and look for clues there.

page2.text:
After doing a circuit of the neighborhoods, we return to the intersection.
There was nothing out of the ordinary in our area.
All that's left is to search the hill on the European side, and we can go as far as Ryudou Temple if we want to expand our search area...

page3.text:
"Huh?"
A sudden chill runs up my spine.
"Saber, that's...!?"
Saber looks in the direction of Shinto. She must have better senses than me.

page4.text:
...Whatever I sensed is fading.
But it was unmistakably a scream accompanied by a strong wave of magical energy.
...
I knew it.
It's the entire reason we're looking around outside.
But why won't my brain work?

page5.text:
"...!"
I told myself I was ready to fight.
Any hesitation disappeared the moment I risked my life.
But now, my body won't listen to my brain.

page6.text:
...It's too soon.
I never expected that we'd hit the mark on the first day.
So I can't move. I may be used to being attacked, but I'm not used to going on the attack.
I'm such an idiot.
I kept saying I was ready to die, but I never thought about killing anyone else...

page7.text: "The scream stopped. The presence we sensed is fading. I don't know what just happened, but I doubt we'll be able to help whoever was attacked."

page8.text:
...
Then, it passes.
My frozen brain and paralyzed limbs move again.
The fear of watching someone die drives away
the fear of an imminent battle of life and death.

page9.text:
"I'm sorry, Saber...!"
I break into a sprint, apologizing for my own spinelessness.
I dash towards the source of the scream, and the battle that left such ominous magical energy.
I'm not ready.
My legs are shaking even as I run.
That's the correct response.
If I lack the will to fight, to want the Holy Grail for myself, then that fear will inevitably come for me.
